versos.hebraico: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־אָדָ֔ם הִנָּבֵ֖א אֶל־הָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ הָרֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר־יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: You, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel, and say, You mountains of Israel, hear Yahweh’s word.
controles.kjv: Also, thou son of man, prophesy unto the mountains of Israel, and say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord:
controles.livre: E tu, filho do homem, profetiza ao os montes de Israel, e dize: Ó montes de Israel, ouvi a palavra do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֣עַן אָמַ֧ר הָאוֹיֵ֛ב עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם הֶאָ֑ח וּבָמ֣וֹת עוֹלָ֔ם לְמֽוֹרָשָׁ֖ה הָ֥יְתָה לָּֽנוּ׃

controles.web: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Because the enemy has said against you, Aha! and, The ancient high places are ours in possession;
controles.kjv: Thus saith the Lord God; Because the enemy hath said against you, Aha, even the ancient high places are ours in possession:
controles.livre: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Dado que o inimigo disse sobre vós: Ha, ha! Até os antigos lugares altos se tornaram propriedade nossa!

versos.hebraico: לָכֵן֙ הִנָּבֵ֣א וְאָמַרְתָּ֔ כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה יַ֣עַן בְּיַ֡עַן שַׁמּוֹת֩ וְשָׁאֹ֨ף אֶתְכֶ֜ם מִסָּבִ֗יב לִֽהְיוֹתְכֶ֤ם מֽוֹרָשָׁה֙ לִשְׁאֵרִ֣ית הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וַתֵּֽעֲל֛וּ עַל־שְׂפַ֥ת לָשׁ֖וֹן וְדִבַּת־עָֽם׃

controles.web: therefore prophesy, and say, Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Because, even because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that you might be a possession to the residue of the nations, and you are taken up in the lips of talkers, and the evil report of the people;
controles.kjv: Therefore prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord God; Because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that ye might be a possession unto the residue of the heathen, and ye are taken up in the lips of talkers, and are an infamy of the people:
controles.livre: Portanto profetiza, e dize: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Por isso, por terem vos desolado e devorado desde o redor, para que fôsseis possuídos pelo resto das nações, e fostes trazidos aos lábios dos fofoqueiros, à infâmia do povo,

versos.hebraico: לָכֵן֙ הָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר־אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה כֹּֽה־אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְ֠הוִה לֶהָרִ֨ים וְלַגְּבָע֜וֹת לָאֲפִיקִ֣ים וְלַגֵּאָי֗וֹת וְלֶחֳרָב֤וֹת הַשֹּֽׁמְמוֹת֙ וְלֶעָרִ֣ים הַנֶּעֱזָב֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָי֤וּ לְבַז֙ וּלְלַ֔עַג לִשְׁאֵרִ֥ית הַגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִסָּבִֽיב׃ס

controles.web: therefore, you mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Yahweh: Thus says the Lord Yahweh to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes and to the cities that are forsaken, which are become a prey and derision to the residue of the nations that are all around;
controles.kjv: Therefore, ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord God; Thus saith the Lord God to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes, and to the cities that are forsaken, which became a prey and derision to the residue of the heathen that are round about;
controles.livre: Por isso, ó montes de Israel, ouvi a palavra do Senhor DEUS: assim diz o Senhor DEUS aos montes e aos morros, às correntes e aos vales, às ruínas, aos lugares devastados, e às cidades abandonadas, que foram saqueadas e escarnecidas pelo resto das nações que há ao redor.

versos.hebraico: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ אִם־לֹ֠א בְּאֵ֨שׁ קִנְאָתִ֥י דִבַּ֛רְתִּי עַל־שְׁאֵרִ֥ית הַגּוֹיִ֖ם וְעַל־אֱד֣וֹם כֻּלָּ֑א אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתְנֽוּ־אֶת־אַרְצִ֣י׀ לָ֠הֶם לְמ֨וֹרָשָׁ֜ה בְּשִׂמְחַ֤ת כָּל־לֵבָב֙ בִּשְׁאָ֣ט נֶ֔פֶשׁ לְמַ֥עַן מִגְרָשָׁ֖הּ לָבַֽז׃

controles.web: therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the nations, and against all Edom, that have appointed my land to themselves for a possession with the joy of all their heart, with despite of soul, to cast it out for a prey.
controles.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea, which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart, with despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey.
controles.livre: Por isso assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Certamente no fogo do meu zelo falei contra o resto das nações, e contra todo Edom, que se apropriaram de minha terra por herança, com alegria de todo coração, com desprezo na alma, para que fosse saqueada.

versos.hebraico: לָכֵ֕ן הִנָּבֵ֖א עַל־אַדְמַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֡ לֶהָרִ֣ים וְ֠לַגְּבָעוֹת לָאֲפִיקִ֨ים וְלַגֵּאָי֜וֹת כֹּֽה־אָמַ֣ר׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה הִנְנִ֨י בְקִנְאָתִ֤י וּבַחֲמָתִי֙ דִּבַּ֔רְתִּי יַ֛עַן כְּלִמַּ֥ת גּוֹיִ֖ם נְשָׂאתֶֽם׃

controles.web: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and tell the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys, Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my wrath, because you have borne the shame of the nations:
controles.kjv: Prophesy therefore concerning the land of Israel, and say unto the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my fury, because ye have borne the shame of the heathen:
controles.livre: Portanto profetiza sobre a terra de Israel, e dize aos montes, aos morros, às correntes, e aos vales: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que falei em meu zelo e em meu furor, porque levastes sobre vós a humilhação das nações.

versos.hebraico: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אֲנִ֖י נָשָׂ֣אתִי אֶת־יָדִ֑י אִם־לֹ֤א הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָכֶ֣ם מִסָּבִ֔יב הֵ֖מָּה כְּלִמָּתָ֥ם יִשָּֽׂאוּ׃

controles.web: therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: I have sworn, Surely the nations that are around you, they shall bear their shame.
controles.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; I have lifted up mine hand, Surely the heathen that are about you, they shall bear their shame.
controles.livre: Por isso assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eu prometo  que as nações que estão ao redor de vós levarão sua humilhação sobre si mesmas.

versos.hebraico: וְאַתֶּ֞ם הָרֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עַנְפְּכֶ֣ם תִּתֵּ֔נוּ וּפֶרְיְכֶ֥ם תִּשְׂא֖וּ לְעַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֥י קֵרְב֖וּ לָבֽוֹא׃

controles.web: But you, mountains of Israel, you shall shoot out your branches, and yield your fruit to my people Israel; for they are at hand to come.
controles.kjv: But ye, O mountains of Israel, ye shall shoot forth your branches, and yield your fruit to my people of Israel; for they are at hand to come.
controles.livre: Porém vós, ó montes de Israel, produzireis vossos ramos, e dareis vosso fruto a meu povo Israel; porque logo virão.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֖י הִנְנִ֣י אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וּפָנִ֣יתִי אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וְנֶעֱבַדְתֶּ֖ם וְנִזְרַעְתֶּֽם׃

controles.web: For, behold, I am for you, and I will turn into you, and you shall be tilled and sown;
controles.kjv: For, behold, I am for you, and I will turn unto you, and ye shall be tilled and sown:
controles.livre: Porque eis que estou convosco; e me voltarei a vós, e sereis lavrados e semeados.

versos.hebraico: וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֤י עֲלֵיכֶם֙ אָדָ֔ם כָּל־בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כֻּלֹּ֑ה וְנֹֽשְׁבוּ֙ הֶֽעָרִ֔ים וְהֶחֳרָב֖וֹת תִּבָּנֶֽינָה׃

controles.web: and I will multiply men on you, all the house of Israel, even all of it; and the cities shall be inhabited, and the waste places shall be built;
controles.kjv: And I will multiply men upon you, all the house of Israel, even all of it: and the cities shall be inhabited, and the wastes shall be builded:
controles.livre: E farei multiplicar homens sobre vós, a toda a casa de Israel, a ela toda; e as cidades serão habitadas, e as ruínas serão reedificadas.

versos.hebraico: וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֧י עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם אָדָ֥ם וּבְהֵמָ֖ה וְרָב֣וּ וּפָר֑וּ וְהוֹשַׁבְתִּ֨י אֶתְכֶ֜ם כְּקַדְמֽוֹתֵיכֶ֗ם וְהֵטִֽבֹתִי֙ מֵרִאשֹׁ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: and I will multiply on you man and animal; and they shall increase and be fruitful; and I will cause you to be inhabited after your former estate, and you will do better than at your beginnings: and you shall know that I am Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And I will multiply upon you man and beast; and they shall increase and bring fruit: and I will settle you after your old estates, and will do better unto you than at your beginnings: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.
controles.livre: E multiplicarei homens e animais sobre vós; e se multiplicarão, e crescerão; e vos farei habitar como no passado, e vos farei melhor que em vossos princípios; e sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְהוֹלַכְתִּי֩ עֲלֵיכֶ֨ם אָדָ֜ם אֶת־עַמִּ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וִֽירֵשׁ֔וּךָ וְהָיִ֥יתָ לָהֶ֖ם לְנַחֲלָ֑ה וְלֹא־תוֹסִ֥ף ע֖וֹד לְשַׁכְּלָֽם׃ס

controles.web: Yes, I will cause men to walk on you, even my people Israel; and they shall possess you, and you shall be their inheritance, and you shall no more henceforth bereave them of children.
controles.kjv: Yea, I will cause men to walk upon you, even my people Israel; and they shall possess thee, and thou shalt be their inheritance, and thou shalt no more henceforth bereave them of men.
controles.livre: E farei andar homens sobre vós: o meu povo Israel; e eles te possuirão, e tu lhes serás sua herança, e nunca mais exterminarás seus filhos.

versos.hebraico: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֚עַן אֹמְרִ֣ים לָכֶ֔ם אֹכֶ֥לֶת אָדָ֖ם אתי וּמְשַׁכֶּ֥לֶת גויך הָיִֽית׃

controles.web: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Because they say to you, You are a devourer of men, and have been a bereaver of your nation;
controles.kjv: Thus saith the Lord God; Because they say unto you, Thou land devourest up men, and hast bereaved thy nations;
controles.livre: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Dado que dizem de vós: Tu és devoradora de homens, e exterminadora dos filhos de teu povo,

versos.hebraico: לָכֵ֗ן אָדָם֙ לֹא־תֹ֣אכְלִי ע֔וֹד וגויך לֹ֣א תכשלי־ע֑וֹד נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

controles.web: therefore you shall devour men no more, neither bereave your nation any more, says the Lord Yahweh;
controles.kjv: Therefore thou shalt devour men no more, neither bereave thy nations any more, saith the Lord God.
controles.livre: Por isso, não devorarás mais homens, e nem mais exterminarás os filhos de teus povos, diz o Senhor DEUS.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹא־אַשְׁמִ֨יעַ אֵלַ֤יִךְ עוֹד֙ כְּלִמַּ֣ת הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְחֶרְפַּ֥ת עַמִּ֖ים לֹ֣א תִשְׂאִי־ע֑וֹד וגויך לֹא־תַכְשִׁ֣לִי ע֔וֹד נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס

controles.web: neither will I let you hear any more the shame of the nations, neither shall you bear the reproach of the peoples any more, neither shall you cause your nation to stumble any more, says the Lord Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Neither will I cause men to hear in thee the shame of the heathen any more, neither shalt thou bear the reproach of the people any more, neither shalt thou cause thy nations to fall any more, saith the Lord God.
controles.livre: E nunca mais te deixarei ouvir a vergonha dos povos, e nunca mais levarás sobre ti a humilhação das nações, nem mais exterminarás os filhos de teu povo, diz o Senhor DEUS.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
controles.kjv: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
controles.livre: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: בֶּן־אָדָ֗ם בֵּ֤ית יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יֹשְׁבִ֣ים עַל־אַדְמָתָ֔ם וַיְטַמְּא֣וּ אוֹתָ֔הּ בְּדַרְכָּ֖ם וּבַעֲלִֽילוֹתָ֑ם כְּטֻמְאַת֙ הַנִּדָּ֔ה הָיְתָ֥ה דַרְכָּ֖ם לְפָנָֽי׃

controles.web: Son of man, when the house of Israel lived in their own land, they defiled it by their way and by their doings: their way before me was as the uncleanness of a woman in her impurity.
controles.kjv: Son of man, when the house of Israel dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their own way and by their doings: their way was before me as the uncleanness of a removed woman.
controles.livre: Filho do homem, quando a casa de Israel morava em sua terra, eles a contaminaram com seus caminhos e com suas ações; o caminho deles diante de mim foi como imundície de menstruada.

versos.hebraico: וָאֶשְׁפֹּ֤ךְ חֲמָתִי֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם עַל־הַדָּ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־שָׁפְכ֣וּ עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וּבְגִלּוּלֵיהֶ֖ם טִמְּאֽוּהָ׃

controles.web: Therefore I poured out my wrath on them for the blood which they had poured out on the land, and because they had defiled it with their idols;
controles.kjv: Wherefore I poured my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land, and for their idols wherewith they had polluted it:
controles.livre: Por isso derramei minha ira sobre eles, por causa do sangue que derramaram sobre a terra, e por causa de seus ídolos com que a contaminaram.

versos.hebraico: וָאָפִ֤יץ אֹתָם֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם וַיִּזָּר֖וּ בָּאֲרָצ֑וֹת כְּדַרְכָּ֥ם וְכַעֲלִילוֹתָ֖ם שְׁפַטְתִּֽים׃

controles.web: and I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed through the countries: according to their way and according to their doings I judged them.
controles.kjv: And I scattered them among the heathen, and they were dispersed through the countries: according to their way and according to their doings I judged them.
controles.livre: E os dispersei pelas nações, e foram espalhados pelas terras; eu os julguei conforme seus caminhos e conforme seus atos.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּב֗וֹא אֶל־הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֣אוּ שָׁ֔ם וַֽיְחַלְּל֖וּ אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשִׁ֑י בֶּאֱמֹ֤ר לָהֶם֙ עַם־יְהוָ֣ה אֵ֔לֶּה וּמֵאַרְצ֖וֹ יָצָֽאוּ׃

controles.web: When they came to the nations, where they went, they profaned my holy name; in that men said of them, These are the people of Yahweh, and are gone out of his land.
controles.kjv: And when they entered unto the heathen, whither they went, they profaned my holy name, when they said to them, These are the people of the Lord, and are gone forth out of his land.
controles.livre: E quando chegaram às nações para onde foram, profanaram meu santo nome, pois deles se dizia: Estes são povo do SENHOR, e da terra dele saíram.

versos.hebraico: וָאֶחְמֹ֖ל עַל־שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשִׁ֑י אֲשֶׁ֤ר חִלְּל֨וּהוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בַּגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֥אוּ שָֽׁמָּה׃ס

controles.web: But I had respect for my holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations, where they went.
controles.kjv: But I had pity for mine holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the heathen, whither they went.
controles.livre: Porém eu os poupei em favor a meu santo nome, o qual a casa de Israel profanou entre as nações para onde foram.

versos.hebraico: לָכֵ֞ן אֱמֹ֣ר לְבֵֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה לֹ֧א לְמַעַנְכֶ֛ם אֲנִ֥י עֹשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֤י אִם־לְשֵׁם־קָדְשִׁי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חִלַּלְתֶּ֔ם בַּגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֥אתֶם שָֽׁם׃

controles.web: Therefore tell the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord Yahweh: I don’t do this for your sake, house of Israel, but for my holy name, which you have profaned among the nations, where you went.
controles.kjv: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord God; I do not this for your sakes, O house of Israel, but for mine holy name’s sake, which ye have profaned among the heathen, whither ye went.
controles.livre: Portanto dize à casa de Israel: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eu não faço isso por vós, ó casa de Israel, mas sim por causa de meu santo nome, o qual vós profanastes entre as nações para onde fostes.

versos.hebraico: וְקִדַּשְׁתִּ֞י אֶת־שְׁמִ֣י הַגָּד֗וֹל הַֽמְחֻלָּל֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר חִלַּלְתֶּ֖ם בְּתוֹכָ֑ם וְיָדְע֨וּ הַגּוֹיִ֜ם כִּי־אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה בְּהִקָּדְשִׁ֥י בָכֶ֖ם לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: I will sanctify my great name, which has been profaned among the nations, which you have profaned in their midst; and the nations shall know that I am Yahweh, says the Lord Yahweh, when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes.
controles.kjv: And I will sanctify my great name, which was profaned among the heathen, which ye have profaned in the midst of them; and the heathen shall know that I am the Lord, saith the Lord God, when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes.
controles.livre: Pois santificarei meu grande nome, que foi profanado entre as nações, o qual vós profanastes no meio delas; e as nações saberão que eu sou o SENHOR, diz o Senhor DEUS, quando eu for santificado em vós, diante de olhos delas.

versos.hebraico: וְלָקַחְתִּ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ מִן־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְקִבַּצְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִכָּל־הָאֲרָצ֑וֹת וְהֵבֵאתִ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֶל־אַדְמַתְכֶֽם׃

controles.web: For I will take you from among the nations, and gather you out of all the countries, and will bring you into your own land.
controles.kjv: For I will take you from among the heathen, and gather you out of all countries, and will bring you into your own land.
controles.livre: Porque eu vos tomarei das nações, e vos ajuntarei de todas as terras, e vos trarei para vossa própria terra.

versos.hebraico: וְזָרַקְתִּ֧י עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם מַ֥יִם טְהוֹרִ֖ים וּטְהַרְתֶּ֑ם מִכֹּ֧ל טֻמְאוֹתֵיכֶ֛ם וּמִכָּל־גִּלּ֥וּלֵיכֶ֖ם אֲטַהֵ֥ר אֶתְכֶֽם׃

controles.web: I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.
controles.kjv: Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.
controles.livre: Então aspergirei água pura sobre vós, e sereis purificados; eu vos purificarei de todas vossas imundícies, e de todos os vossos ídolos.

versos.hebraico: וְנָתַתִּ֤י לָכֶם֙ לֵ֣ב חָדָ֔שׁ וְר֥וּחַ חֲדָשָׁ֖ה אֶתֵּ֣ן בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם וַהֲסִ֨רֹתִ֜י אֶת־לֵ֤ב הָאֶ֨בֶן֙ מִבְּשַׂרְכֶ֔ם וְנָתַתִּ֥י לָכֶ֖ם לֵ֥ב בָּשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: I will also give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.
controles.kjv: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.
controles.livre: E vos darei um novo coração, e porei um novo espírito dentro de vós; e tirarei de vossa carne o coração de pedra, e vos darei um coração de carne.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־רוּחִ֖י אֶתֵּ֣ן בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם וְעָשִׂ֗יתִי אֵ֤ת אֲשֶׁר־בְּחֻקַּי֙ תֵּלֵ֔כוּ וּמִשְׁפָּטַ֥י תִּשְׁמְר֖וּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶֽם׃

controles.web: I will put my Spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and you shall keep my ordinances, and do them.
controles.kjv: And I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and ye shall keep my judgments, and do them.
controles.livre: E porei meu Espírito dentro de vós, e farei com que andeis em meus estatutos, guardeis meus juízos, e os pratiqueis.

versos.hebraico: וִישַׁבְתֶּ֣ם בָּאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לַאֲבֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם וִהְיִ֤יתֶם לִי֙ לְעָ֔ם וְאָ֣נֹכִ֔י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: You shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; and you shall be my people, and I will be your God.
controles.kjv: And ye shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; and ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.
controles.livre: E habitareis na terra que dei a vossos pais; e vós sereis meu povo, e eu serei vosso Deus.

versos.hebraico: וְהוֹשַׁעְתִּ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם מִכֹּ֖ל טֻמְאֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וְקָרָ֤אתִי אֶל־הַדָּגָן֙ וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֣י אֹת֔וֹ וְלֹא־אֶתֵּ֥ן עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם רָעָֽב׃

controles.web: I will save you from all your uncleanness: and I will call for the grain, and will multiply it, and lay no famine on you.
controles.kjv: I will also save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the corn, and will increase it, and lay no famine upon you.
controles.livre: E eu vos livrarei de todas as vossas imundícies; e chamarei ao trigo, e o multiplicarei, e não vos darei fome.

versos.hebraico: וְהִרְבֵּיתִי֙ אֶת־פְּרִ֣י הָעֵ֔ץ וּתְנוּבַ֖ת הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה לְמַ֗עַן אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹ֣א תִקְח֥וּ ע֛וֹד חֶרְפַּ֥ת רָעָ֖ב בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃

controles.web: I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that you may receive no more the reproach of famine among the nations.
controles.kjv: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that ye shall receive no more reproach of famine among the heathen.
controles.livre: Também multiplicarei o fruto dos árvores, e o produto do campo, para que nunca mais recebais a humilhação da fome entre as nações.

versos.hebraico: וּזְכַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־דַּרְכֵיכֶ֣ם הָרָעִ֔ים וּמַעַלְלֵיכֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־טוֹבִ֑ים וּנְקֹֽטֹתֶם֙ בִּפְנֵיכֶ֔ם עַ֚ל עֲוֺנֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְעַ֖ל תּוֹעֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: Then you shall remember your evil ways, and your doings that were not good; and you shall loathe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.
controles.kjv: Then shall ye remember your own evil ways, and your doings that were not good, and shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.
controles.livre: Então vos lembrareis de vossos maus caminhos, e de vossos atos que não foram bons; e tereis nojo de vós mesmos por vossas maldades, e por vossas abominações.

versos.hebraico: לֹ֧א לְמַעַנְכֶ֣ם אֲנִֽי־עֹשֶׂ֗ה נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יִוָּדַ֖ע לָכֶ֑ם בּ֧וֹשׁוּ וְהִכָּלְמ֛וּ מִדַּרְכֵיכֶ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

controles.web: Nor for your sake do I this, says the Lord Yahweh, be it known to you: be ashamed and confounded for your ways, house of Israel.
controles.kjv: Not for your sakes do I this, saith the Lord God, be it known unto you: be ashamed and confounded for your own ways, O house of Israel.
controles.livre: Não faço isto por vós, diz o Senhor DEUS, notório vos seja; envergonhai-vos e humilhai-vos de vossos caminhos, ó casa de Israel.

versos.hebraico: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה בְּיוֹם֙ טַהֲרִ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם מִכֹּ֖ל עֲוֺנֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וְהֽוֹשַׁבְתִּי֙ אֶת־הֶ֣עָרִ֔ים וְנִבְנ֖וּ הֶחֳרָבֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: In the day that I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will cause the cities to be inhabited, and the waste places shall be built.
controles.kjv: Thus saith the Lord God; In the day that I shall have cleansed you from all your iniquities I will also cause you to dwell in the cities, and the wastes shall be builded.
controles.livre: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: No dia que vos purificar de todas as vossas maldades, então farei as cidades serem habitadas, e as ruínas serão reedificadas.

versos.hebraico: וְהָאָ֥רֶץ הַנְּשַׁמָּ֖ה תֵּֽעָבֵ֑ד תַּ֚חַת אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיְתָ֣ה שְׁמָמָ֔ה לְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־עוֹבֵֽר׃

controles.web: The land that was desolate shall be tilled, whereas it was a desolation in the sight of all who passed by.
controles.kjv: And the desolate land shall be tilled, whereas it lay desolate in the sight of all that passed by.
controles.livre: E a terra assolada será lavrada, em lugar de ser assolada diante dos olhos de todos os que passavam;

versos.hebraico: וְאָמְר֗וּ הָאָ֤רֶץ הַלֵּ֨זוּ֙ הַנְּשַׁמָּ֔ה הָיְתָ֖ה כְּגַן־עֵ֑דֶן וְהֶעָרִ֧ים הֶחֳרֵב֛וֹת וְהַֽנְשַׁמּ֥וֹת וְהַנֶּהֱרָס֖וֹת בְּצוּר֥וֹת יָשָֽׁבוּ׃

controles.web: They shall say, This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities are fortified and inhabited.
controles.kjv: And they shall say, This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities are become fenced, and are inhabited.
controles.livre: E dirão: Esta terra que era assolada ficou como o jardim do Éden; e as cidades abandonadas, assoladas e arruinadas estão fortalecidas e habitadas.

versos.hebraico: וְיָדְע֣וּ הַגּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִֽשָּׁאֲרוּ֮ סְבִיבוֹתֵיכֶם֒ כִּ֣י׀ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה בָּנִ֨יתִי֙ הַנֶּ֣הֱרָס֔וֹת נָטַ֖עְתִּי הַנְּשַׁמָּ֑ה אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי וְעָשִֽׂיתִי׃ס

controles.web: Then the nations that are left around you shall know that I, Yahweh, have built the ruined places, and planted that which was desolate: I, Yahweh, have spoken it, and I will do it.
controles.kjv: Then the heathen that are left round about you shall know that I the Lord build the ruined places, and plant that that was desolate: I the Lord have spoken it, and I will do it.
controles.livre: Então as nações que restarem ao vosso redor saberão que eu, o SENHOR, reedifico as cidades destruídas, e replanto as assoladas; eu, o SENHOR, falei e farei.

versos.hebraico: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה ע֗וֹד זֹ֛את אִדָּרֵ֥שׁ לְבֵֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לָהֶ֑ם אַרְבֶּ֥ה אֹתָ֛ם כַּצֹּ֖אן אָדָֽם׃

controles.web: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: For this, moreover, will I be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them: I will increase them with men like a flock.
controles.kjv: Thus saith the Lord God; I will yet for this be enquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them; I will increase them with men like a flock.
controles.livre: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Ainda permitirei serei buscado pela casa de Israel para lhes fazer isto: eu os multiplicarei de pessoas como a ovelhas.

versos.hebraico: כְּצֹ֣אן קָֽדָשִׁ֗ים כְּצֹ֤אן יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ בְּמ֣וֹעֲדֶ֔יהָ כֵּ֤ן תִּהְיֶ֨ינָה֙ הֶעָרִ֣ים הֶחֳרֵב֔וֹת מְלֵא֖וֹת צֹ֣אן אָדָ֑ם וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס

controles.web: As the flock for sacrifice, as the flock of Jerusalem in her appointed feasts, so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men; and they shall know that I am Yahweh.
controles.kjv: As the holy flock, as the flock of Jerusalem in her solemn feasts; so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men: and they shall know that I am the Lord.
controles.livre: Tal como as ovelhas santificadas, como as ovelhas de Jerusalém em suas solenidades, assim também as cidades desertas serão cheias de rebanhos de pessoas; e saberão que eu sou o SENHOR.
